name: String Manipulation
description: Transforms string values in one column, for example upper-casing, trimming, replacing or concatenating. The result can replace the column or be appended as a new one.

op.title: Operation
op.description: String operation applied to the column values.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Replace the source column or append the result as a new column.

search.title: Search text
search.description: Text to find and replace (replace only).

value.title: Value
value.description: Replacement text for replace (empty deletes the search text) or appended text for concat (empty leaves the value unchanged).
